description: Attach a dev -> review -> fix flow to an existing run: the dev agent commits, the review agent reviews it, and the engine moves the loop. Both agents must already belong to that run; `repo` defaults to the run working directory. Writes one flow file and sends nothing — a flow only moves when someone ticks it, which this server never does on its own. Refuses a second flow on the same run, and refuses to replace an active one.

dev.description: Dev agent id or nickname inside that run.

dev_stall_max_attempts.description: Re-nudges before an idle plan item escalates (default 2).

dev_timeout_sec.description: Seconds an idle dev may hold a plan item before a retry (default 900).

max_rounds.description: Fix rounds the flow may spend before it escalates (default 6).

replace.description: Start over on a run whose flow is closed (escalated or done). An active flow is never replaced.

repo.description: Project directory the flow watches; defaults to the run working directory.

review.description: Review agent id or nickname inside that run; must differ from dev.

review_timeout_sec.description: Seconds a requested review may stay unanswered before it escalates (default 900).

run_id.description: Run id, or a unique prefix of it. A flow is keyed by run id.

name: flow_start
